posts.trend: White-collar hiring grows 2% in September; AI/ML jobs surge 20%: Naukri
posts.context: Tech and corporate companies push employees to learn AI as a magic solution to structural workplace problems.
posts.angle: AI initiatives are implemented to drive productivity rather than help employees with actual stress.
slides: Your company's new AI initiative is a chatbot that tells you to work harder.

"Hi, I am your AI career assistant."
"How can I help you today?"
"I want a better work-life balance."
"Based on your profile, I recommend learning prompt engineering."

The machine is fully aligned with management.

It does not take casual leave.
posts.caption: Somebody you work with has "AI Transformation Lead" in their internal bio now. 🤖
posts.rank_verdict: The AI chatbot trope is highly generic and prevents the post from achieving a genuinely fresh angle.
